description: Fork of exp611 with E=144, d_v=24, D=384 (continuing exp681's co-adaptation test at smaller dims). All LUT shapes (tph, NAP) identical to exp611. Param breakdown: qkv_lut unchanged 18.87M (n_out=2*d_qk=128). v_lut: 6*512*64*24 = 4.72M/L = 28.31M (was exp611 75.50M). out_proj: 1*1024*64*144 = 9.44M/L = 56.62M (was 150.99M). read_out unchanged 18.87M (out=D=384). tok_emb_E: 32768*144 = 4.72M (was 12.58M). unembedder unchanged 12.58M. Total ~140M. LUT bandwidth ~11.91 MB/token (1.78x less than vanilla, 1.78x less than exp611). Tests how far the exp611-arch co-adaptation extends. Note: H*d_v = 144 = E (nice symmetry). References: exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M, exp681 = 1.4159 @ 216M (-11 mb at -25% params), exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (current <100M SOTA).
